scientific_integrity: An all-rank argument uses graphic incidence total unimodularity and a Jacobian calculation. Finite verification over n=3..8 checks regression identities only. Gorensteinness alone is not claimed new relative to earlier general braid-cone theory.
scientific_limitations: The singular-locus dimension, the singular fixed-point counts and explicit entire affine charts are proved; the global irreducible component number and incidences for n>=5 are not computed. Equivalent statements in unindexed literature remain possible. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Binomial hypersurface charts and codimension-three singularities of cycle graphical-zonotope toric varieties
